result.topic_en: Boundary conditions for a vibrating elastic lamina with a freely movable end B carrying a force: the vanishing of the moment and of the ordinate lead to the values of the constants A, B, C, D and to the transcendental frequency equation $e^{2\zeta}=\tan(\frac{1}{2}\rho+\zeta)$.
result.transcription:
LAMINARVM ELASTICARVM. 473
sustinere vim $B\beta = G$, positoque vt ante $\frac{\theta a}{b} = \zeta$, fieri oportet
$-\frac{Kcc\theta^3}{b^3}(A\,\sin.\zeta - B\cos.\zeta + C.e^{\zeta} - D.e^{-\zeta}) + G = 0,$
ita vt iam cognoscamus hanc vim $B\beta$ quae erit
$G = Kcc.\frac{\theta^3}{b^3}\cos.\theta\theta t(A\,\sin.\zeta - B\cos.\zeta + Ce^{\zeta} - De^{-\zeta}),$
deinde autem momentum harum virium, necessario hic debet euanescere, quia enim lamina circa B libere mobilis est, nullum momentum incuruans hic statui potest, erit ergo:
$A\cos.\zeta + B\sin.\zeta - Ce^{\zeta} - De^{-\zeta} = 0$
denique hic manifesto esse debet $y = 0$, vnde fit
$A\cos.\zeta + B\sin.\zeta + Ce^{\zeta} + De^{-\zeta} = 0$
ex quibus duabus postremis aequationibus statim fluit
$A\cos.\zeta + B\sin.\zeta = 0$ et $Ce^{\zeta} + De^{-\zeta} = 0,$
ex qua postrema fit
$C = e^{-\zeta}$ et $D = -e^{\zeta},$
qui valores insuper in lineolam paruam sunt ducendi, vt applicatae $y$ fiant lineares et simul infinite paruae, hinc ergo colligitur
$A = e^{-\zeta} - e^{\zeta}$; $B = e^{-\zeta} + e^{\zeta},$
quibus valoribus substitutis prodibit sequens aequatio
$0 = e^{-\zeta}(\cos.\zeta + \sin.\zeta) - e^{\zeta}(\cos.\zeta - \sin.\zeta)$ siue
$\mathrm{Tang}.\zeta = \frac{e^{\zeta} - e^{-\zeta}}{e^{\zeta} + e^{-\zeta}}$; vel $e^{2\zeta} = \frac{\cos.\zeta + \sin.\zeta}{\cos.\zeta - \sin.\zeta},$
formula per reductiones notissimas redit ad hanc
$e^{2\zeta} = \mathrm{Tang}.(\frac{1}{2}\rho + \zeta).$
Tom. XVII. Nou. Comm. Ooo Hinc

items.english: then the moment of these forces must necessarily vanish here, since the lamina is freely movable about B, no bending moment can be posited here
